summary: Iter 108c regression test — manual tournament status gate removal. Verified: (1) TournamentDetail header STATUS now reads 'In Progress · not permitted' (from effectiveStatus, not stored 'Draft'); (2) SquadDetail no longer shows 'still in Draft' banner and player-pool search/filters/inputs remain usable; (3) Match Calendar API returns 200 and POST returns 422 validation (not 400 status-block); (4) President's status-action bar shows ONLY 'Mark Completed' + 'Cancel' (obsolete 'Open Squad Selection' and 'Start Tournament' buttons removed); (5) Match Official Console renders minimal 3-tile dashboard with no tabs at /dashboard for official@mpca.in; (6) Tournament listing loads without crash; (7) RBAC scope enforcement holds — Division token with X-Body-Type:State header still returns scope=DIV-IND; (8) The 10-test test_iter108_rbac.py pytest suite still passes.
critical_code_review_comments: TournamentDetail.jsx effectiveStatus computed inline in render — should ideally be memoized with useMemo keyed on [t.start_date, t.end_date, t.status] to avoid recomputation on every re-render, though impact is negligible.

effectiveStatus does NOT check t.status !== 'Cancelled'/'Completed' before deriving from dates — a Cancelled tournament whose window is currently live would still render 'In Progress' in the STATUS pill. Consider: `if (t.status === 'Cancelled' || t.status === 'Completed') return t.status;` at the top of the derivation. Recommend adding one small pytest/UI case for this edge.

The stored DB `status` field remains 'Draft' for JS Anand Trophy even though calendar says In Progress. Tournament listing page filter buckets still read from stored status. Known follow-up per user note — no crash observed, but flagging: listing UX is now inconsistent with detail-page STATUS pill until a backend backfill/derived-status endpoint aligns them.
